ev.q: The open world is set in a large shopping mall
Frank must survive by scavenging weapons to fight zombies
they fall under two categories, melee and ranged
trapped inside a shopping mall in the town of Willamette, Colorado
The player has 72 in-game hours (6 hours in real time) to finish the main story
Dead Rising incorporates a role-playing element in the form of an experience system
